facts.fact: BPP Director General Adebowale Adedokun said on 2026-10-08 that the electronic government procurement system being developed by the Bureau will move federal bidding fully online, with Education Ministry and federal university submissions already processed digitally on PCOMS.

NGA.note: Procurement reform only; digital certificates are a plan, not a service in use.
Does not say who builds the e-GP system or that government staff run it.
Online community procurement is for businesses; no local government office connection stated.
